title: Gloriosus Dei apostolus Bartholomeus (Motetti de la corona IV) (Bauldeweyn)
desc: Noel Bauldeweyn, Gloriosus Dei apostolus Bartholomeus (Motetti de la corona IV). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Motetti de la corona IV. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
